'''Trans-oceanic shuttles''' were atmospheric [[Transport/Legends|transport]] craft used on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. They ferried individuals and cargo between the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] continents. The [[EAV Bothan Whale|EAV ''Bothan Whale'']] was a trans-oceanic shuttle operating out of [[Fortuna Spaceport]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
